description: Milestone 3 Steps 7-9 screening thresholds and service reallocation rules for Manhattan bus routes.

underused_screening.note: Targets route x time-band cells in roughly the bottom 20% of riders per service-hour without frequent high-demand alerts.

high_demand_screening.note: Targets route x time-band cells flagged high-demand >=65% of active hours AND carrying >=40 riders/service-hour (above network median ~34), excluding sparse low-volume outliers like M35.

coverage_guardrails.note: Routes serving >=60% exclusive stops cannot be discontinued or deeply cut without losing unique street coverage; cap trims at -10%.

shared_corridor_overlap.note: Merge feasibility checks apply strictly to shared_corridor pairs (>=40% overlap share) and exclude same_family variants (M15/M15+, M34+/M34A+, M14A+/M14D+).

step8_9_adjustment_rules.demand_assumption_statement: Assumes total route-band ridership stays constant when scheduled trips change (+/-10% or +/-20%), isolating direct mechanical effects on riders per trip and riders per service-hour.
